mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in lower risk-free rates.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5% (t-test p > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 7.5%, it signals economic distress and imminent central bank rate cuts, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 7.5 (t-test p > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent decline in housing starts (HOUST) and GDP growth (GDPC1) below their 6-month moving averages indicates economic contraction, triggering central bank stimulus and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of HOUST and GDPC1 decline fails to produce positive returns in > 60% of cases (t-test p > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising above 1.0% and sustained for 3 months), the S&P 500 experiences negative returns as rate hikes compress equity valuations over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances during FEDFUNDS > 1.0% (t-test p > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below its 12-month moving average indicates weakening manufacturing, which typically precedes central bank rate cuts and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO falls below its 12-month average (t-test p > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 850,000 units, it signals a contraction in the residential sector, prompting fiscal stimulus and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when HOUST < 850 (t-test p > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in employment (PAYEMS) and rise in unemployment (UNRATE) above 7.5% signals labor market deterioration, triggering central bank intervention and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of PAYEMS decline and UNRATE > 7.5 fails to produce positive returns in > 60% of cases (t-test p > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: In the late-cycle expansion regime (GDPC1 growth > 2.5% and RSAFS growth > 1.0% for 3 consecutive quarters), the S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns as the economy approaches a peak and the Fed tightens monetary policy.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances during the late-cycle expansion regime (t-test p > 0.05 for mean return < 0).
